title: Formula AST Node
description: A node in the abstract syntax tree representing a parametric formula expression. Uses a discriminated union on the 'type' field to distinguish between number literals, variable references, binary operations, unary operations, and parenthesized groups.

formulaNode.description: Any valid formula AST node (recursive reference)

type.description: Discriminator indicating a number literal node

value.description: The numeric value of the literal

identifierNode.description: A variable reference (e.g., freq, Q, R) or the special constant 'pi'

type.description: Discriminator indicating a variable reference node

binaryNode.description: A binary operation (e.g., left + right, left * right)

type.description: Discriminator indicating a binary operation node

operator.description: The binary operator: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, or exponentiation

left.description: The left operand of the binary operation

right.description: The right operand of the binary operation

type.description: Discriminator indicating a unary operation node

operand.description: The operand of the unary operation

groupNode.description: A parenthesized expression, preserved for printer fidelity so that round-tripping maintains explicit grouping

type.description: Discriminator indicating a parenthesized group node

expression.description: The expression contained within the parentheses
